October 25, 2026

Obama attacks Trump's Iran war record and mocks Hegseth

tags: politics, war, defence
sources: @aaronparnas

In a campaign speech, former President Barack Obama said the war with Iran was launched seven months ago on the rationale of ending a nuclear weapons program that the 2015 nuclear deal had already blocked without military force. He said U.S. allies and bases have been attacked, Americans have been killed and hundreds wounded, missile stocks have been drawn down, and Iran now holds effective veto power over the Strait of Hormuz, which he blamed for higher oil, diesel and consumer prices. He also mocked Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth for focusing on troops' jaw lines and testosterone levels and on live-streamed executions as a way of cultivating a warrior spirit.

Investigation finds 202 facilities exempted from Clean Air Act rules

tags: climate, health, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

A new investigation reports that since taking office, Donald Trump has granted Clean Air Act exemptions to 202 industrial facilities across 39 states and Puerto Rico, covering chemical manufacturers, copper smelters, sterilizers, steel-related plants and coal-burning power stations. An estimated 3.3 million people live within three miles of at least one of the exempted facilities. The affected sites are concentrated in the South and East of the United States.

Musk says Starlink access for Ukrainian drone strikes was cut off

tags: war, tech, defence
sources: @aaronparnas

Elon Musk stated that using Starlink for offensive drone strikes has never been permitted and said the Ukrainian military violated the service's terms of service by doing so. He said the loophole allowing that use was closed last week. Musk had earlier attributed the decision to the White House.

Trump reported to have claimed $825 million write-off on Florida golf course

tags: politics, legal, markets
sources: @aaronparnas

According to Forbes, Trump took in roughly $1.4 billion from crypto in 2025 and more than $200 million from real estate, facing a projected tax bill of over $500 million. His company donated development rights at his Jupiter, Florida golf course to a land trust on the argument that the course was natural habitat worth protecting, while continuing to operate the club, producing an $825 million write-off. The report says similar arrangements have been used five times since 2005, and that a month after the Jupiter deal he sued the IRS.

Republican operatives voice alarm nine days out from midterms

tags: politics, elections
sources: @aaronparnas

With nine days to the midterm elections, Republican operatives are privately describing the party's position as collapsing, with some saying the race is effectively over. At a Georgia rally, Trump responded to high gas prices by saying his side is making money like never before and that he does not care that people are suffering at the pump. Operatives contrasted his hoarse and halting delivery with Obama's rallies in Michigan and Ohio.

Trump and Obama trade attacks over rallies and White House renovations

tags: politics, elections, media
sources: @aaronparnas

Obama mocked Trump's focus on home renovations at the White House, including a ballroom larger than the building itself, a helicopter pad on the South Lawn and extensive gold decoration. Trump, campaigning in Georgia for Mike Collins against Jon Ossoff, said Obama's Michigan event was empty, though the venue was reported to be full. Overnight on Truth Social, Trump called Obama grossly incompetent as president, said he paid Iran billions, and argued that candidates Obama endorses lose.
